race.comment: BOLERO (8) finished out of the money two starts back then was beaten 2 lengths when fifth in a 2030m contest at Toowoomba eight days ago. Gets 2kg off with the claim and draws favourably in gate two. Nicely placed to get the prize. TRUSTY BANDIT (5) was out of the money two runs back then again missed the frame last start over 2200m at Eagle Farm, beaten 7 lengths into 11th. The engagement of Brandon Lerena is noteworthy. Finds the right race this time and can take this out. CARDIOLOGIST (2) turned in a better run last start, beaten a long neck into fourth over 1800m at Gold Coast. Capable of featuring prominently. LORD PROTECTOR (7) Is not a regular in the winner's stall and continued the trend last start when fourth over 2000m at Ipswich. Finds the right race and can contest for a place.
